newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to discuss ports selloff model today - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to discuss ports selloff model today - paper.

text.p: Brazil's National Privatization Council (CND) will meet on Wednesday to discuss a model for the privatization of Brazilian ports, O Estado de Sao Paulo daily said.
The first four ports to be privatized are the ports of Cabedelo, Itajai, Laguna and Porto Velho, the paper said.
The newspaper said the CND will not discuss the privatization of mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce.

The council was expected to announce Vale's base sale price at this meeting but the announcement was postponed because companies interested in Vale's selloff have requested more time to view information on the firm in the so-called Data Room at Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES).
Vale's privatization is expected to begin in March.
